publications.title: STING activation induces cytotoxic and immune responses in meningiomas via inflammatory cell death pathways.

needs_manual_review_reason: Series overall_design explicitly describes 'Single nucleus multiome (RNA-seq + ATAC-seq) profiling of frozen meningioma specimens' -- corrected from an initial bulk_rna_seq mislabel (the GEO 'Genome binding/occupancy profiling by high throughput sequencing' series type covers the ATAC-seq component of this multiome assay, not a separate ChIP-seq experiment). A sibling accession in the same SuperSeries (GSE323014) was investigated as a possible related record but excluded entirely: its overall_design shows it is a mouse orthotopic model ('whole mouse brains implanted with MGS1 meningioma cells'), not human patient tissue, so it is out of scope per docs/scope.md and does not appear anywhere in this inventory. Per-sample clinical/pathology fields not yet extracted from individual GSM records. COMPLETENESS UPDATE (2026-07-10 fact-check pass): publications was empty even though the parent SuperSeries GSE297764 carries Series_pubmed_id=41680157 (same publication already correctly linked on the sibling record gse-297637-bulk-rnaseq); added here too. PMID 41680157 (Youngblood et al., Nature Communications, 2026) verified via PubMed esummary: title matches this GEO SuperSeries title exactly, not retracted or corrected. FACT-CHECK (2026-07-11): corresponding_author corrected from 'Mark,W,Youngblood, Shashwat,,Tripathi' to 'Amy,B,Heimberger' only. Fetched the paper's open-access PMC full text (PMC13009160) directly and searched every author entry (47 total): exactly one is marked corresp="yes", Amy B. Heimberger (amy.heimberger@northwestern.edu), the paper's senior/last author; neither Youngblood nor Tripathi carries a corresponding-author designation despite both being GEO Series_contributors. Same correction applied to the sibling record gse-297637-bulk-rnaseq.json. found_via extended to include citation_chain and verification_tier upgraded 2 to 1, since the publication link is now independently corroborated via full-text verification beyond the original keyword_api discovery.

gene_expression_viewer.sample_label: RNA arm only, all 4 patients merged (this record's ATAC arm is not part of this viewer)
gene_expression_viewer.embedding_method: scanpy 1.10.3: read_10x_mtx(gex_only=True) of the series-level combined RNA+ATAC Cell Ranger ARC output for all 4 patients (NU0821/NU1142/NU1617/NU1795), which filters the 36601-gene + 72866-peak combined feature matrix down to Gene Expression features only. QC per sample (min 200 genes/cell, <20% pct_counts_mt), anndata.concat (unintegrated), filter_genes min_cells=3 (33689 genes), normalize_total+log1p, top-2000 HVG, PCA, neighbors, UMAP, Leiden (resolution 0.5, 12 clusters, igraph flavor). Gene panel: 11 guaranteed meningioma driver genes + top HVGs by dispersion to 150 total.
gene_expression_viewer.integration_note: This record's sample_count is 8 (4 patients x GEX+ATAC), but this viewer covers only the 4 GEX/RNA samples -- the ATAC arm (chromatin accessibility) has no equivalent in this project's gene-expression viewer and was not processed here. Samples merged by raw concatenation, not batch-corrected/integrated (same approach ScPCA documents for its own merged objects).
